optifine.notes: OptiFine's shaders run under Horizon's shader layer; Volt Lapse reads the camera after OptiFine's own placement, so a cinematic camera still wins.

realms.notes: A Realm is recorded like any server: the mod never needs server-side installation.

replay_format.reads: files this engine writes up to format 1
replay_format.refuses: a newer format or opcode version with a clear message

server_plugins.notes: Vanilla, Spigot, Paper and Fabric/Quilt/Forge servers are all fine; Volt Lapse is client-only.

server_versions_note: Recording is client-side, so any server the Horizon client can join works, including 1.8 proxies and ViaVersion setups; the list is what has been exercised. Replay files do not depend on the server version.

sodium_iris.notes: Iris shader packs render through the same layer; the renderer captures the post-shader frame.
